newsitem.title: USA: SmithKline Hycamtin promising for lung cancer.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline Hycamtin promising for lung cancer.

text.p: SmithKline Beecham Plc said Monday its drug Hycamtin may offer a promising new treatment option for patients suffering from advanced squamous cell lung cancer, a subtype of non-small-cell lung cancer.
SmithKline said patients with advanced squamous cell lung cancer who were treated with Hycamtin as first-line therapy achieved a 23 percent response rate.
Currently, there is no standard treatment for non-small-cell lung cancer, it said.
Hycamtin is currently indicated for use in the treatment of patients with recurrent, metastatic ovarian cancer.
